config.hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5, the N=64 force reference keeps improving after step 3000. At a matched 6000-step horizon, the N=64 minus N=128 trained force R2 gap stays at least 0.04 in both seeds 20-21 (data_seed 0, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls). The N=128 6000-step references are 0.748 (seed 20) and 0.686 (seed 21). Values come from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. Horizon check: step-3000 trained force R2 (same-layer control plus margin) must be within 0.03 of the 3000-step N=64 m2-fixed runs (0.763 / 0.789); otherwise the result is reported as horizon-confounded.
